CustomField.description: Key Contact - the main person you interact with, often influential in decision making process. Decision Maker - the person with final authority to approve or reject the deal. Influencer - someone who doesnt make the final decision, but had significant sway over it. Champion - an internal advocate who pushes for your solution within the company, Accounts - go to contact in Account department; Claims - go to contact in Claims department
